_doc: Machine-readable twin of Ink_Painting_System.md. Paint every batch from these templates as they stand; when an owner note changes a rule, change the system doc and this file together.

T-D.text: Traditional Chinese xieyi freehand ink painting on plain warm rice paper: spontaneous, expressive brushwork, each form suggested in a few bold strokes, ink bleeding softly into the paper, dry-brush flicks, large areas of untouched paper. Black-and-grey ink with a single faint wash of {element wash}. {Wide landscape, one-corner composition | Tall portrait | Square}, subject off-centre, most of the paper empty. Subject: {subject}. No people, no text, no calligraphy, no seal, no border.

T-STAGE.text: Minimal Chinese shanshui ink wash painting in the manner of Ni Zan and Ma Yuan, on plain warm rice paper. Most of the paper is left blank (liubai). Level-distance composition: the whole scene is a thin band along the bottom fifth of the paper, made of very few brushstrokes; distant forms are single pale grey washes with no detail, near forms a handful of light strokes, at most one small dark accent. Soft mist separates the planes. Pale diluted ink with a barely visible tint of {element wash}. Tall portrait. Subject: {subject}. No people, no text, no seal, no border.

T-STRIP.text: Minimal Chinese ink wash painting in a tall narrow hanging-scroll format, in the manner of Song album leaves and Ma Yuan, on plain warm rice paper. Few brushstrokes, pale grey ink with darker accents on the main subject, soft mist, generous blank paper around it. The main subject is clear and readable, filling the middle height of the scroll; the right side dissolves into mist and blank paper. A faint {energy wash} on the {energy's thing} and a faint {core wash} on the {stem object}. Subject: {stem object acting the relation with the energy}. The {stem object} is the darkest, most distinct form in the painting. No people, no hands, no text, no seal, no border.

T-PAIR.text: Minimal Chinese ink wash painting as a landscape album leaf (3:2), in the manner of Song album leaves and Ma Yuan, on plain warm rice paper. Few brushstrokes, pale grey ink with darker accents on the main subject, soft mist, generous blank paper. The main subject is clear and readable, set slightly left of centre; the edges dissolve into mist and blank paper. A faint {energy wash} on the {energy's thing} and a faint {core wash} on the {stem object}. Subject: {the same scene as the stem's strip, widened}. The {stem object} is the darkest, most distinct form in the painting. No people, no hands, no text, no seal, no border.

T-HERO.text: Minimal Chinese shanshui ink wash painting in the manner of Ma Yuan and Ni Zan, on plain warm rice paper, toned like a pale misty background plate. Landscape 3:2. The subject sits in the upper two thirds; the lower third is mist and blank paper. Few strokes, pale diluted ink, one darker accent, most of the paper blank (liubai). A barely visible {element wash}. Subject: {the energy element's yang or yin image}. No people, no text, no seal, no border.
